title: AGU Registry and NHS
official: Aspartylglucosaminuria (AGU) Registry and Natural History Study (AGU Registry).
summary: The Aspartylglucosaminuria (AGU) Registry and Natural History Study (AGU Registry) aims to gain a more comprehensive understanding of Aspartylglucosaminuria (AGU) disease through an in-depth understanding of the disease progression in global patient population and burden of the disease on the family and caretakers.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have molecularly confirmed diagnosis of AGU disease by Genomic DNA mutation
* Have a confirmation of AGU disease determined through urine or blood tests
* The participant or the participant's LARs or Designated Representatives are able to understand the nature, scope, and possible consequences of the study
* The participant or LARs or Designated Representatives agree to comply with web-based, protocol-defined study procedures and data collections

Exclusion Criteria:

* Person signing the study consent is unable to read and understand English (French, Spanish, Finnish and other languages as available and applicable)
